title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs

prompt.location: Table 1 (Stage-II instruction template, used for the authors' own RankRAG model); baselines run 'zero-shot...without additional demonstrations'

claim.metric: Average score across 9 QA/dialogue benchmarks (EM/Acc/F1 composite), zero-shot, no RAG

data.source: NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikimQA, FEVER, Doc2Dial, TopiOCQA, Inscit (all public QA/dialogue benchmarks, several via the KILT collection)

notes: Per-dataset sizes are not itemized alongside the results table in the excerpt reviewed, so a single clean n_items for the composite Avg. metric is unclear (soft gap); any one of the 9 datasets could instead be cited individually (e.g. NQ EM=41.5) if per-dataset test sizes are consulted. Footnote confirms first-hand observation of GPT-4-turbo's RAG refusal behavior, indicating the authors ran it themselves rather than citing a public report.
